author: Chtulhusaurus
body: My IGN for minecraft is SovietPanda. (changed) I was banned under the username Jug_jug_cola. The reason I was banned was Aimbot AutoCrit on December 14, 2014. I was banned by Emmaye. I believe I should be unbanned from the server because first of all, I was being accused of hacking because I was lagging. Having slow internet makes it look like I am teleporting but I still don't understand why I was banned for AutoCrit/Aimbot. I was banned without a warning either. This is my first time being banned, and haven't thought to appeal since. I think I've waited a fair amount of time for a ban. Thanks.

title: Appealing an infraction

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

I have decided to appeal your ban because you have waited for a while now, in addition there is no video evidence of you hacking.

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
